Home.hero: Split layout. Left: High impact heading (Outfit font), trust badges, dual CTA (Apply Now, Track Visa). Right: Subtle visual containing 'Accra skyline' or 'passport travel' image with overlay.
Home.how_it_works: 3-step visual grid (Submit Form -> Pay -> Receive Visa) using icons and short descriptions.
Home.visa_types: Pricing cards comparing Regular (5-7 days, Green theme) and Express (48-72h, Gold theme).
Home.trust_section: Security icons, secure payment badges, fast processing metrics.

ApplicationForm.layout: 2-column Desktop (grid-cols-12). Left (col-span-8): Multi-step form. Right (col-span-4): Sticky summary panel.
ApplicationForm.form_steps: 1. Personal details. 2. Passport details. 3. Travel dates (Departure date compliance warning here). 4. Uploads (Face, Passport Copy, Cover, Ticket).
ApplicationForm.live_summary: Glassmorphism sticky card showing: Selected Visa Type, Processing Speed, Base Price, Surcharge (if Express), Total Price, and the Visa Sample Preview Card mock.

Payment.content: Order summary at top. Tabs or vertical stack for payment methods. Hubtel Visa/Mastercard form active. USDT slot styled as disabled with 'Coming Soon' badge.

Tracking.search_box: Large input field for Application ID + 'Track' button.
Tracking.result: Vertical Timeline component showing Submitted -> In Progress -> Done. Include status text and dates.

AdminDashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation + Main content area ('Control Room' grid). Sidebar dark mode (#0A0A0A).
AdminDashboard.kpi_cards: Top row of 4 cards: Total Applications, Revenue, Pending (Red alert color), Approved (Green success color).
AdminDashboard.table: Dense data table. Columns: ID, Applicant, Date, Type, Status, Actions. Include filter/search bar.
AdminDashboard.actions_modal: Slide-out or Dialog showing full applicant details and uploaded documents for review.

AdminSettings.layout: Sidebar nav + Main area. Main area uses vertical or horizontal Tabs for the 5 sections.
AdminSettings.sections: 1. Visa Prices (Inputs for base prices). 2. Visa Types (Toggle switches). 3. Payment Methods (Toggle switches for Hubtel/Crypto). 4. Hubtel Config (API Key inputs). 5. Communication (WhatsApp Number input, Email templates).

hero_backgrounds.description: Accra landmark building, useful for hero background or subtle overlay
Aerial view of Accra, useful for contextual trust sections

contextual_images.description: Person holding a passport, perfect for 'How it works' or application form context
Person proudly holding the Ghana flag, excellent for trust and national pride sections

accessibility_and_motion.motion: Use crisp, quick transitions (150ms-200ms ease-out). No excessive bouncy animations to maintain official feel. Accordions and modals should slide and fade gracefully.
accessibility_and_motion.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios for text on Green and Red backgrounds. Use 'data-testid' on all form inputs, buttons, and summary elements for testing. Use sr-only labels for icon buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic tailwind blue or purple.
Install Google Fonts 'Inter' and 'Outfit'. Apply 'font-sans' to Inter and create a custom utility 'font-heading' mapped to Outfit in tailwind.config.js.
The visa sample preview card requires a customized CSS blur to simulate blurred text and QR codes. Implement this exactly as described in the components.visa_sample_card JSON node.
Admin dashboard must use a dense layout with precise alignment.
Ensure 'Hubtel' payment integration is mocked visually if API isn't built yet, and disable the USDT option distinctly.
